Runtimes: Deno (profilarr), Bun (ConvertX), Elixir, .NET, Go x2, Node, Python, PHP, Ruby. No Rust this batch. Root Dockerfile present for 9 of 10 (not leantime).

Risk profilarr: Risk: Deno runtime is rare; Dockerfile.parser is a second Dockerfile; develop is default branch; data is a mounted config dir (storage by local data, not S3); needs Radarr/Sonarr to be useful but starts alone.
Risk convertx: Risk: converter binaries (ffmpeg, imagemagick etc.) are installed in the image, heavy image; SQLite and uploads need a persistent dir; auth setup on first run; JWT secret env.

Risk teslamate: Risk: app lives under elixir/ subdirectory while Dockerfile is at root; Grafana dashboards are a separate service; needs Tesla API token at runtime for real use, but boots without it; MQTT broker optional.

Risk kavita: Risk: default branch is develop; sqlite on config dir; needs mounted library folder; Dockerfile uses prebuilt build artifacts (build.sh, copy_runtime.sh) so root Docker build may not be self-contained; Angular UI in UI/.
Risk remark42: Risk: Go module is in backend/ not root; BoltDB file needs persistent dir; SECRET and SITE env required; frontend built in Dockerfile.
Risk etherpad: Risk: default DB is dirty file on disk, Postgres is optional config; pnpm workspace; default branch develop; plugins install at runtime; settings.json.docker.

Risk bakerydemo: Risk: demo/sample site rather than product; SQLite default, Postgres via DATABASE_URL; media uploads on local disk; Node build for static assets; Procfile and heroku.yml also present.
Risk leantime: Risk: needs MySQL/MariaDB, which is outside Postgres-only MVP data scope (expect unsupported datastore); Dockerfile is under .docker/ not root; file uploads on local disk.

Risk zammad: Risk: very large app; official image is multi-process (web, websocket, scheduler) in one Dockerfile; Elasticsearch optional and not supported by MVP; storage defaults to DB or filesystem.

Risk ntfy: Risk: Dockerfile expects prebuilt binary from goreleaser (copies from build context); web app in web/ built by make; SQLite cache and attachment dirs optional; Postgres supported in newer versions.
CI: teslamate failure=2 and remark42 failure=2 check runs at pinned commit; zammad has no GitHub check runs (uses GitLab CI). Informational only.
